name: ObjectivesCompletedObjectives
summary: The `completedObjectives` member body of the Objectives replicated state in the client reader's NON-ZERO count branch: a prefix-varint element count, one raw mask byte per chunk of eight elements, then that many `codec.objectives-tracked-objective` elements. It shares its reader (0x143a69460) and element layout with `trackedObjectives`, so the two members differ only in their zero-count branch (0x143a69fb0 here, +0x78). A zero count selects that branch (an optional delta, then a counted u64 run bounded to 33,554,432), which this card does not model, so an empty set must clear the member's presence bit. PROVEN LAYOUT, NOT PROVEN MEANINGS; no live record exists, so the evidence is partial, never measured.
purpose: Name the `completedObjectives` member layout (group 1 member 2 of codec.objectives-replicated-state) so the state card references a record instead of carrying the container's layout itself.

fields.name: elements
fields.note: The prefix-varint count read by FUN_14087b760, then one raw mask byte per chunk of eight via 0x14087a330, then the elements. The reader is 0x143a69460, the +0x30 slot of member vtable 0x1482599b0 (the same function as trackedObjectives); the writer is +0x28 = 0x142f882a0. The client takes its +0x78 zero branch (0x143a69fb0) when the count is zero, so the generated codec models only a non-empty set and an empty set must clear the member's presence bit instead of sending an empty container.

evidence.ref: Member reader 0x143a69460 (vtable 0x1482599b0 +0x30, build 30fe6461): count FUN_14087b760, chunk mask 0x14087a330, then the element loop. No capture sets the member's mask bit; the 'lab cannot drive server-authoritative state' negative in research/atlas/meanings.md explains why.

Zero-count branch 0x143a69fb0 (vtable +0x78) calls FUN_143a078d0: optional delta via FUN_1461adf60, then a prefix-varint count (refused above 0x2000000) and that many u64be via FUN_14087af30. It is a sibling layout, not this card.
